components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact primary action for refreshes and safe, confirmed commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:26px; padding:0 10px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); background:var(--color-primary, #0a84ff); color:#fff; font:500 12px var(--font-sans, system-ui); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover, #3399ff); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(10,132,255,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, rgba(10,132,255,.6)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity:.88; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet companion action that remains readable without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:26px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--border-glass, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); background:var(--bg-control, rgba(255,255,255,.07)); color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); font:500 12px var(--font-sans, system-ui); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--bg-card-hover, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, rgba(10,132,255,.6)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity:.88; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact system search field with a direct, high-contrast focus treatment.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" placeholder="חיפוש לפי פורט או תהליך…" aria-label="חיפוש">
components.css: .ds-input-search { width:100%; height:30px; padding:0 10px; border:1px solid var(--border-glass, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); background:var(--bg-control, rgba(255,255,255,.07)); color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); font:12px var(--font-sans, system-ui); outline:none; transition:border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color:var(--text-muted, #86868b); opacity:1; } .ds-input-search:focus { border-color:var(--color-primary, #0a84ff); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--focus-ring, rgba(10,132,255,.6)); }

components.name: Navigation Row
components.description: The compact sidebar command row; active state identifies the current system workspace.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:100%; min-height:30px; padding:4px 8px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); background:transparent; color:var(--text-secondary, #a1a1a6); font:450 13px var(--font-sans, system-ui); text-align:start; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-row svg { width:15px; height:15px; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background:var(--surface-hover, rgba(255,255,255,.06)); color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); } .ds-nav-row-active { background:var(--surface-selected, rgba(10,132,255,.2)); color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); font-weight:600; } .ds-nav-row-active svg { color:var(--color-primary, #0a84ff); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, rgba(10,132,255,.6)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Segmented Filter
components.description: A compact mutually exclusive filter group for view modes and process subsets.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:2px; border:1px solid var(--border-glass, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); background:rgba(0,0,0,.15); } .ds-segment { height:24px; padding:0 8px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--text-secondary, #a1a1a6); font:450 11.5px var(--font-sans, system-ui); cursor:pointer; } .ds-segment:hover { color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); background:var(--surface-hover, rgba(255,255,255,.06)); } .ds-segment-active { background:var(--bg-card-active, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); font-weight:550; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15); } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, rgba(10,132,255,.6)); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Process Inspector
components.description: Progressive disclosure for the selected process, separated from the live table by a single hairline.
components.css: .ds-inspector { min-width:280px; padding:16px; border-inline-start:1px solid var(--border-glass, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-sidebar, #1c1c20) 84%, var(--bg-app, #1e1e22)); color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); font:13px var(--font-sans, system-ui); } .ds-inspector dl { display:grid; gap:0; margin:12px 0 0; } .ds-inspector dl div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:92px 1fr; gap:12px; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-glass, rgba(255,255,255,.08)); } .ds-inspector dt { color:var(--text-muted, #86868b); font-size:11px; } .ds-inspector dd { margin:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; color:var(--text-primary, #f5f5f7); font:11px var(--font-mono, ui-monospace); }

narrative.overview: Port Manager is a task-dense, local-first macOS workspace. It should let a developer scan a live system state, find the relevant process, and take a guarded action without decorative friction. The shell is quiet and dark-first by default; contrast, grouping, and selected state do the hierarchy work.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, scan-first information density with one clear workspace focus.
System typography for UI; monospaced values only where technical data benefits from alignment.
Tonal layering and hairline separators before elevated surfaces.
Semantic color communicates action and risk; blue is reserved for focus, selection, and primary action.
State motion is brief, optional, and never hides content.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use blue for primary action, current selection, and focus only. Do not add it as a decorative border, panel wash, or ubiquitous icon color.

rules.name: The Scanline Rule
rules.body: Never use display typography or fluid type scales in product UI. A developer must be able to compare labels and data at a glance.

rules.name: The Native Depth Rule
rules.body: Do not combine a decorative wide shadow with a visible 1px card border. Prefer tonal layering and separators; elevate only when a surface truly floats above the workspace.

dos: Do keep Ports and Processes the dominant workspace; use tables, selection, separators, and a conditional inspector to make live state legible.
Do use semantic green, yellow, and red only to communicate system status, safety, or consequence.
Do preserve full keyboard access, visible focus, RTL/LTR behavior, selectable technical values, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do keep routine transitions within the existing 140–220ms system; use motion only for state change, feedback, or a clearly triggered overlay.
donts: Don't make the app resemble a web dashboard, a fake macOS desktop, a neon developer console, or an iOS card-heavy app.
Don't add gradients, glow, fake traffic lights, or indiscriminate transparency. Real Electron window capabilities take precedence over imitation.
Don't use blue as decoration, or use non-semantic saturated colors on inactive surfaces.
Don't turn every dataset into cards or make modal dialogs the first solution; prefer inline disclosure and split-pane inspection.
Don't hide content behind entrance motion, or rely on color alone to communicate a safety state.
